shots.alt: The Render dialog: a draft of the car on the left with the four Render buttons under it, and on the right its Preset, Quality, Look, Size, Background, Light and Lights in the model.
shots.caption: File › Render… (F9): the draft on the left is what Render draws.

shots.alt: The car rendered at Best in the Product look on white, path traced: glossy red and black plastic, clear windows, a soft shadow under it.
shots.caption: Quality › Best, Look › Product: the car as a set's box shows it.

shots.alt: The car rendered at Best in the Product look with Plastic › Played with: its greys a little yellowed, dust on the tops of its studs, each part seated its own way.
shots.caption: Plastic › Played with: the car as a set played with for years.

shots.alt: The Render dialog with On a wooden table chosen under Background: the draft shows the car on the table's colour; at Best in the Product look the wood's own grain is drawn and a light stands near the model.
shots.caption: Background › On a wooden table: at Best, in the Product look, the model stands on real wood.

shots.alt: The car rendered at Best in the Product look on a wooden table, path traced and lit from behind as by a window: the black studs on its roof catch white highlights, its shadow falls forward onto the grain, and the wood keeps its own colour.
shots.caption: On a wooden table at Best: lit from behind, as by a window, so glossy tops shine as a photograph's do.
features: lib:a large source on a table

shots.alt: The car drawn by the Line art look: black lines on white, thickest round the outline, the shading in halftone dots and its shadow on the floor in dots too.
shots.caption: Look › Line art: the model inked, to print or colour in.

shots.alt: The Render dialog with Light set to Dark and one bulb added under Lights in the model: the draft shows the car lit by the bulb alone, and the bulb's strength, size, shadows and where it hangs are on the right.
shots.caption: Lights in the model, Add › Bulb, with Light on Dark.
